messages:
mei: quick note — bringing up ember-v0.9 q4-pertoken on staging; seeing token-boundary collapse in mixed JP/KR samples when context > 512.

javier: how visible is it in metrics?

mei: short numbers: fp16 sacreBLEU 30.8 -> q4 27.9 (drop ~2.9), chrF -0.038. Most failures grouped under 'mixed_jp_kr_ruby' subset.

tasha: sample?

mei: compact diff: 
REF: 新宿(しん) 사람가능이다。
FP16: 新宿(しん) 사람가능이다。
Q4: 新宿(しん)사람가능이다。
(see missing space between ) and Hangul)

javier: encode ids match between paths?

mei: yes encode same. tokenizer offsets differ: fp16 offsets [(0,2),(2,6),(6,9),(9,12)] vs q4 [(0,2),(2,9),(9,12)] — merged subtokens in q4 path.

infra-bot: canary deployed ember-v0.9-q4 -> staging (2 replicas).

tasha: repro command used?

mei: ./eval.sh --model ember-v0.9 --quant q4 --kv-cache on --max-tokens 2048 --batch 12 --suite mixed_long_jpkr

javier: hypothesis: per-token quant scaling + kv-cache offset assembly rounding. quick checks: 1) re-run with --kv-cache off, 2) run single-worker, single-batch, 3) log kvcache alignment warnings.

mei: did #1 — with kv-cache off the sample matches fp16 and BLEU gap almost gone. logs show repeated: WARN kvcache: align_shift delta=1.

tasha: plan: patch kv-assembler to use 64-bit accumulators for offset reconstruction and add a mixedscript fuzz to eval harness. also add a tiny per-locale delta metric in console.

javier: please add a blocking label for Dedicated rollouts until we have a fix.

mei: will open PR with repro files and minimal failing set. eval-bot: queued a focused rerun with --workers 1 and --disable-prefetch.
